title: Magnetia Modpack
body:
# **Magnetia Events Modpack**
## The official modpack for Magnetia Events on Minecraft 1.21.11.

This pack includes the mods youll need to join our events, along with a few extras to make the game run better. It is really similar to vanilla while it improves performance and multiplayer experience.


_Included in the pack:_

1. Performance and optimization mods for better FPS
1. Simple Voice Chat for proximity voice communication
1. A few quality of life improvements
1. Everything needed to enjoy Magnetia events

Take care from the entire magnetia staff team! :3
